messages.author: 5f94295e0980aa5d
messages.subject: Isolation by distance?
parts:
Hi,
I noticed that there is the option of inputting geographic data such as xy coordinates when you import a file using poppr. I was just wondering if there are any tests that use this data, such as a test for isolation by distance, included in the poppr package? I have both microsatellite and SNP data. 

Thanks!
Melanie

messages.author: 251f569434b3da1e
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Isolation by distance?
parts:
Hi Melanie,

You can get an index of files in an R package with:

library(help = "poppr")

Poppr extends adegenet, so you might check it too:

library(help = "adegenet")

I see:

adegenet::monmonier
adegenet::spca

which may be relevant to your query.

Good luck!
Brian

messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Isolation by distance?
parts:
In addition, if you have clonal populations, you can use the function "autocorrelation" from the package RClone.

There is also the function "mantel.randtest" from the ade4 package.

Hope that helps!
Zhian
